Name: WORLD_MAP_LEGACY_CONV_PARAM_ST
Description: Places maps that aren't overworld tiles (legacy dungeons, catacombs, underground maps) on the world map. Each base point row links a source map to a destination map by one matching point; positions in the source map are moved by (destination point − source point) before they're drawn, so map pins (such as graces) and place names land in the right place. A link works both ways, and a destination that isn't an overworld tile (area 50–88, e.g. m60/m61) is chained through that map's own link, so legacy maps can be linked to each other. Built when the world map is set up.

Fields.Name: Source Map Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X of the matching point, in source map coordinates. The conversion offset is destination X minus this.

Fields.Name: Source Map Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) of the matching point, in source map coordinates. Carried into the offset, but the world map is top-down, so it has no visible effect.

Fields.Name: Source Map Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z of the matching point, in source map coordinates. The conversion offset is destination Z minus this.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Area
Fields.Description: AA part of the destination map mAA_BB_CC_00. 50–88 (e.g. 60 the Lands Between, 61 the Land of Shadow) is an overworld tile; any other map must itself have a base point row, which is followed to reach an overworld tile.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the destination map mAA_BB_CC_00.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the destination map mAA_BB_CC_00.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X of the same point, in destination map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) of the same point, in destination map coordinates. No visible effect on the top-down map.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z of the same point, in destination map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Is Base Point
Fields.Description: Only base point rows are used. A map keeps the first link that reaches an overworld tile (direct links in row order, then chained ones); later base point rows for the same map are ignored. Rows with this off appear unused by the game.
